added.n: Overlay Controller Xbox Series X - Lime Drip Lines Edition
added.ne: Xbox Series X Controller Overlay - Lime Drip Lines Edition
added.d: Edisi overlay controller Xbox Series X bertema Lime Drip Lines yang bergerak mengikuti gamepad. Tombol, stik, dan trigger ikut bereaksi saat ditekan. Untuk OBS atau Streamlabs.
added.de: Xbox Series X controller overlay, Lime Drip Lines theme, that moves along with your gamepad. Buttons, sticks and triggers react when pressed. For OBS or Streamlabs.
ft: Body bergambar goresan hijau lime neon dengan efek tetesan
Tetesan lime kecil jatuh pelan di sisi kiri body
Trigger terisi cat lime seperti tuangan saat ditarik
Bumper dan tombol menyala lime penuh saat ditekan
Stik karet hijau lime dengan cincin charcoal
Daily Streak: hitungan hari main berturut-turut di plat atas dan layar Home
Suasana body makin terang mengikuti intensitas permainan
Warna aksen tombol dan stik bisa diganti lewat pengaturan
fte: Body artwork with neon lime brush strokes and drip effects
Small lime drips slowly fall on the left side of the body
Triggers fill with lime paint like a pour when pulled
Bumpers and buttons light up solid lime when pressed
Green lime rubber sticks with charcoal rings
Daily Streak: consecutive play day counter on the top plate and Home display
Body mood gets brighter with play intensity
Button and stick accent color can be changed in settings

added.n: Overlay Controller Xbox Series X - Sunny Triangle Shards V2 Edition
added.ne: Xbox Series X Controller Overlay - Sunny Triangle Shards V2 Edition
added.d: Edisi overlay controller Xbox Series X bertema Sunny Triangle Shards V2 yang bergerak mengikuti gamepad. Tombol, stik, dan trigger ikut bereaksi saat ditekan. Untuk OBS atau Streamlabs.
added.de: Xbox Series X controller overlay, Sunny Triangle Shards V2 theme, that moves along with your gamepad. Buttons, sticks and triggers react when pressed. For OBS or Streamlabs.
ft: Gaya body pecahan segitiga kuning tajam, paling rapat di ujung grip
Rage Mode: tekan cepat memicu retakan merah menyebar di body
Bintang pecahan berkilau satu per satu di display Home
Animasi YOUR NAME muncul-hilang menggantikan plat atas (ganti lewat ?name=)
Meter Heat berupa segitiga pop-in di bawah nama, hanya terlihat saat tombol ditekan beruntun
Grip menyala kuning mengikuti stik, tombol, dan intensitas main
Percikan pecahan saat tombol A B X Y dan stik ditekan
Trigger isi kuning bermotif segitiga, bumper tersapu garis kuning
Easter egg: tahan LB RB View untuk Sunburst, tahan Y untuk bintang
fte: Sharp yellow triangle-shard body art, densest at the grip tips
Rage Mode: fast mashing spreads red cracks across the body
Twinkling shard star on the Home display, one shard at a time
YOUR NAME appear/disappear animation replaces the top plate (change via ?name=)
Heat meter is pop-in shards under the name, visible only while mashing buttons
Grips glow yellow with stick, button and play intensity
Shard sparks when A B X Y buttons and sticks are pressed
Triangle-pattern trigger fill, bumpers swept by a yellow line
Easter eggs: hold LB RB View for Sunburst, hold Y for the star
